children: Agilent Technologies reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $1.88B and diluted EPS of $1.28, up versus the prior-year quarter as broad-based demand and operational initiatives supported margin expansion.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue growth was broad-based across segments and regions, with net revenue up 8% year over year for both the quarter and year-to-date.
Life Sciences & Diagnostics led with 11% growth in the quarter, driven by strength in pharma, pathology and genomics; CrossLab and Applied Markets also expanded.
Product and consumables demand remained strong (including LC, LC‑MS, consumables and Agilent Advanced Therapeutics), with services growth in repair and maintenance.

Operational initiatives included completion of the Biocare acquisition, supply-chain optimization, targeted pricing and restructuring actions expected to realize approximately $30–35M in annual cost savings.
Gross and operating margins improved, aided by higher volume, tariff refunds, pricing actions and a favorable product mix.
